cards.about: Athanasius on why no one but the Word of God could save.
cards.author: Athanasius of Alexandria
cards.work: On the Incarnation of the Word
cards.translation: Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, vol. 4 (1892)
cards.excerpt: it belonged to none other to bring man back from the corruption which had begun, than the Word of God, Who had also made them from the beginning.
